Graduated from a **Master in Management** at Excelia Business School, I am passionate about **digital and new technologies.** Creative, proactive, versatile and with a good understanding of digital and marketing, **I am confident in my ability to tackle new missions.** Organized and rigorous, I possess a range of key business and interpersonal skills that I have developed through my professional experiences.

- [💼 Experience](#experience)
- [🧑🏻‍💻 Side Project](#side-project)
- [🎓 Education](#education)
- [🤹🏼‍♂️ Skills](#skills)
- [🏐 Interests](#interests)

## Experience

### Marketing Project Manager @**[Octopia](https://octopia.com)**

`Oct 2021 - Today`

Responsible for **the acquisition and marketing development of the Octopia Products offer** in order to develop the activity and e-commerce sales in France and internationally.

### Marketing Project Manager @[Microsoft](https://microsoft.net)

`Sept 2019 - Sept 2020`

Participation in the implementation of Microsoft France’s marketing plan for the Education audience (Primary/Secondary and Higher Education) in order to **develop the network of teachers and partner schools.**

### Digital Project Manager @[Havana Club International](https://havana-club.com)

`Jan 2019 - Jul 2019`

As part of the International Marketing team and under the responsibility of the Senior Brand Manager, I participate in the launch and follow-up of **international digital projects** for Havana Club International, a subsidiary of Pernod Ricard group.

### Digital Project Manager @[Pernod Ricard France](https://www.pernod-ricard.com/fr/nos-marches/france)

`Jul 2018 - Jan 2019`

Support to the Digital Manager on the deployment of the **digital strategy of the Havana Club brand on the French market.**

## Side Project

### Cofounder & Project Manager @[Fabrilab](https://fabrilab.net)

`Sept 2017 - Today`

Creation of a communication agency in the form of a micro-enterprise. Fabrilab supports self-employed and small businesses in their **digital transition.**

- Main clients : TotalEnergies, Solis International, SCEBOG (1st agricultural cooperative of Guyana)...

## Education

### Master in Management @[Excelia BS](https://www.excelia-group.com)

`Sept 2016 - Sept 2020`

Member of the «Conférence des Grandes Ecoles», AMBA, AACSB, EQUIS and EPAS accredited. Graduate of a master in management, specialising in Marketing & Brand Management.

## Skills

### Hard Skills:

- 🇬🇧 English
- 🇪🇸 Spanish
- 🤹🏼‍♂️ Project Management
- 🌐 WordPress
- 💻 Digital Marketing
- 🎨 Adobe CC
- 🔍 SEO
- 📊 Microsoft 365
- 📨 E-CRM Management
- 📱 Social Media Management

### Soft Skills:

- 🎨 Creative
- 📚 Curious
- 🤝🏼 Team Spirit

## Interests

### Sports:

- 🏄🏽‍♂️ Bodyboarding & Surfing
- 🏊🏼‍♂️ Swimming

|                                                       |                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| ![Bodyboarding](/static/images/bodyboarding-raph.jpg) | ![Wave](/static/images/wave-france.jpg) |

### Others:

- 🗺️ Discovery and Traveling
- 📷 Photography
- 🎶 Music
- ♟️ Chess ➡️ [Chess.com](https://www.chess.com/member/raphythe)

### Humanitarian:

- 🤝🏼 Volunteer teacher in Cambodia in 2017 for 3 months in a children’s centre **"Les Enfants de Klang Leu".** As a teacher, I taught French, English and IT. Practice hygiene rules and help with the daily life of the center.

### Other Experiences:

- **2021:** TikTok Business for Enterprise training
- **2020:** Facebook Spark AR Tutorials
- **2018:** Bike courier for Deliveroo and Uber Eats
- **2018:** Ambassador [ASUS](https://www.asus.com/fr/) Vivobook S and ASUS ZenFone 5
- **2017-2018:** Digital Project Manager of the Student Office of Excela Business School
- **2017:** Hotel receptionist in Australia at the [Nomads Noosa Hotel](https://nomadsworld.com/australia/nomads-noosa/)
- **2016-2017:** Bank teller at [La Poste Group](https://www.lapostegroupe.com/fr) (replacement during the holidays)
- **2015:** Online advisor at [CIC](https://www.cic.fr/fr/index.html) (6-month fixed-term contract)

## Texas Affinity - Affinity APP

### Project Overview:
Built a CRM application for an insurance company with React, Laravel and MariaDB. The application included a data import feature that significantly enhanced overall productivity by reducing to 0% the necessity of sending informative emails.

### Achievements:

- **Successfully developed a comprehensive CRM solution for an insurance company**
- **Implemented a data import feature that eliminated the need for informative emails**
- **Enhanced overall productivity through streamlined data management processes**

**React, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, MariaDB, REST APIs, SQL, MySQL, Object-Oriented Programming**

document.summary: Led the modernization of regulatory processes for an energy utility, leveraging machine learning and a robust data pipeline to optimize maintenance workflows and issue detection.

body.raw:
## [Python/React/Django] ML/AI Integration System

### Project Overview:
Led the modernization of regulatory processes for an energy utility, leveraging machine learning and a robust data pipeline to optimize maintenance workflows and issue detection. The solution, built with React, Django, and PostgreSQL, using Websockets and BroadcastChannel API, integrated seamlessly with machine learning algorithms through REST APIs, providing real-time insights and interactive visualizations for end users.

### Achievements:

- **Designed and implemented a React front-end to present maintenance workflows and machine learning outputs**
- **Developed Django back-end features to facilitate real-time communication with machine learning services**
- **Configured and optimized PostgreSQL for efficient data storage and retrieval**
- **Implemented robust error handling and API management to enhance system reliability**
- **Created dynamic data visualizations for interpreting machine learning insights**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**Python, React, Django, PostgreSQL, WebSocket, REST APIs, Machine Learning, WebSockets, BroadcastChannel API**

document.summary: Contributed to the maintenance, bug fixing, and deployment of a high-security software system for a wind turbine blade wear prediction project in the hydroelectric industry.

body.raw:
## [React/TypeScript/Python/Django] Wind Turbine Blade Wear Prediction System

### Project Overview:
Contributed to the maintenance, bug fixing, and deployment of a high-security software system for a wind turbine blade wear prediction project in the hydroelectric industry. Operated in an offline, tightly controlled environment, deploying updates for both the React front-end and Django back-end. Ensured the system functioned seamlessly in both development and production environments on an IIS server, overcoming restrictions such as the lack of direct internet access.

### Achievements:

- **Diagnosed and resolved critical bugs, maintaining a stable and reliable codebase for production use**
- **Deployed front-end and back-end artifacts to a secure IIS server, adhering to stringent security protocols**
- **Utilized Django APScheduler to ensure scheduled tasks operated reliably in both environments**
- **Coordinated secure artifact transfers, performing integrity checks for successful deployment**
- **Introduced incremental enhancements to the React front-end for improved usability**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**React, TypeScript, Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, IIS, Shell Scripting, styled-components**

document.summary: Designed a CRM with Django, DRF (Django REST Framework), React, and PostgreSQL, saving the company $5 million annually and resolving complex historical data issues.

body.raw:
## [React/TypeScript/Python/Django] Texas Seguros - informativoir.com.br

### Project Overview:
Designed a CRM with Django, DRF (Django REST Framework), React, and PostgreSQL, saving the company $5 million annually. Resolved a complex historical data issue for a contract with SulAmerica, the 2nd largest Brazilian insurance company with more than 7+ million users. Engineered system modules including users, plans, taxes, and dental, ensuring data integrity and reducing processing time by 40%. Optimized database queries to reduce time of requests by 50%, and developed algorithms to calculate income tax statements.

### Achievements:

- **Designed a CRM solution that saved the company $5 million annually**
- **Resolved complex historical data issues for a contract with SulAmerica (7+ million users)**
- **Engineered system modules ensuring data integrity and reducing processing time by 40%**
- **Optimized database queries to reduce request time by 50%**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**React, TypeScript, Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, SQL, Object-Oriented Programming**

document.description: Developed a cross-platform mobile application for professional cyclists to interface with a Bluetooth-enabled power meter device. Built with React Native, the app provided real-time power metrics and performance insights, leveraging AWS services for secure data storage and processing. Successfully deployed to both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, delivering a seamless experience for end users.
document.summary: Developed a cross-platform mobile application for professional cyclists to interface with a Bluetooth-enabled power meter device, leveraging AWS services for secure data storage and processing.

body.raw:
## [React Native/TypeScript] Ictus Power Meter

### Project Overview:
Developed a cross-platform mobile application for professional cyclists to interface with a Bluetooth-enabled power meter device. Built with React Native, the app provided real-time power metrics and performance insights, leveraging AWS services for secure data storage and processing. Successfully deployed to both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, delivering a seamless experience for end users.

### Achievements:

- **Designed and implemented a React Native mobile interface for real-time cycling power metrics**
- **Integrated AWS services including S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway for data management**
- **Successfully deployed the app to both Play Store and App Store with compliance to platform requirements**
- **Collaborated with firmware engineers to ensure seamless Bluetooth communication**
- **Optimized app performance, reducing latency and improving responsiveness under varying network conditions**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**React Native, TypeScript, AWS, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Bluetooth, styled-components**

document.title: [Vue.js/TypeScript/Spring Boot] Wi-SUN Network Simulation Tool
document.description: Developed a comprehensive simulation tool for Wi-SUN network devices, designed to help users visualize device locations and network topology on an interactive map. The project combined a robust Vue.js front-end with Leaflet for mapping, and a Spring Boot back-end with OracleDB for data management and simulations.
document.summary: Developed a comprehensive simulation tool for Wi-SUN network devices, designed to help users visualize device locations and network topology on an interactive map.

body.raw:
## [Vue.js/TypeScript/Spring Boot] Wi-SUN Network Simulation Tool

### Project Overview:
Developed a comprehensive simulation tool for Wi-SUN network devices, designed to help users visualize device locations and network topology on an interactive map. The project combined a robust Vue.js front-end with Leaflet for mapping, and a Spring Boot back-end with OracleDB for data management and simulations.

### Achievements:

- **Designed and implemented a Vue.js front-end integrated with Leaflet for real-time visualization**
- **Built and maintained Spring Boot microservices for CRUD operations and network simulation logic**
- **Integrated OracleDB to securely store device configurations and simulation parameters**
- **Enhanced user authentication mechanisms and implemented basic security measures**
- **Improved team workflows by introducing and maintaining Swagger documentation**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**Vue.js, TypeScript, Spring Boot, OracleDB, Leaflet, Linux, PostgreSQL, Shell Scripting, Vuex, axios**

document.title: [Python/Django] Dispatch Optimization System
document.description: Developed and maintained the web interface for communication with the Dispatch Optimization System (SOD) used at the substation on Fernando de Noronha Island. The web system, built with Django, was designed to integrate with external APIs and simulate data from diesel generators using a proprietary program, ActionView. The project required precise execution in a remote environment with limited internet connectivity and communication.
document.summary: Developed and maintained the web interface for communication with the Dispatch Optimization System (SOD) used at the substation on Fernando de Noronha Island.

body.raw:
## [Python/Django] Dispatch Optimization System

### Project Overview:
Developed and maintained the web interface for communication with the Dispatch Optimization System (SOD) used at the substation on Fernando de Noronha Island. The web system, built with Django, was designed to integrate with external APIs and simulate data from diesel generators using a proprietary program, ActionView. The project required precise execution in a remote environment with limited internet connectivity and communication.

### Achievements:

- **Updated and maintained the Django codebase for seamless communication with external APIs**
- **Integrated and maintained MATLAB scripts for periodic job execution using Django APScheduler**
- **Authored a detailed deployment manual for system implementation in challenging remote environments**
- **Executed deployment and system tests on-site, ensuring 100% functionality despite limited internet**
- **Conducted rigorous testing to validate system stability and accuracy of data exchange**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**Python, Django, MATLAB, CSS, IIS, JavaScript, APScheduler**

---
